name: trained-weight shared execution substitution
purpose: Test whether the completed shared-state checkpoint preserves predictions and provides a practical execution benefit when one state is encoded once for all questions.
locked_data_policy: Use only manifest-bound public development splits. Never load a test split.

arms.P: One state prefix followed by every original sibling-isolated question branch.
arms.B: One single-question encoding per original question, with all encodings in one model batch.
arms.S: The same single-question encodings executed one at a time.

equivalence.population: Every common-clean public development request from the decision, transfer, and Korean suites.
equivalence.evidence_integrity: Each comparison stores authoritative reference and candidate logits. Resume and summary recompute probabilities, log probabilities, actions, margins, and differences at the declared temperatures, require the frozen candidate count, bind base candidates to packed logits, and verify a digest for every completed request transaction.
equivalence.failure_policy: Any same-device gate failure pauses every efficiency conclusion until localized and corrected.

workload_selection.longest_diagnostics: Always include the highest-option-count request in each cell, then fill by packed length without repeating a parent.

timing.mps_synchronization: Immediately before and after every timed operation.
timing.request_schedule: The same frozen request identities and order are reused in every repetition.
timing.counterbalancing: For every stable condition identity, Latin rotation gives each arm every order position once; traversal scope and batch order alternate separately.

scopes.pretokenized_forward: Frozen encoding objects are ready; dynamic collation, attention masks, transfers, encoder, and pointer head are included.
scopes.complete_request: In-memory request validation, tokenization with one state tokenization per request, packing, transfers, model, fixed-temperature probabilities, CPU materialization, and response construction are included. Checkpoint loading and transport are excluded.

primary_gate.comparison: P divided by B on complete_request, request batch size 1, MPS, evaluated separately for decision and Korean multi-question requests.
primary_gate.estimator: Average repeated observations within workload and process, average each workload over repetitions, retain equal workload weighting for the point ratio, and resample actual parent clusters jointly.

memory.observed_maximum_label: Sampled allocation maximum; not a guaranteed allocator peak.
memory.schedule: The exact workload, parent, suite, and batch sequence is frozen before inference and reused for every device and arm.

decision.equivalent_and_faster: Run a narrow emotion and offensive-domain replay ablation while preserving all other recipe settings and excluding development parents.
decision.equivalence_failure: Correct the execution mismatch and repeat this experiment.
decision.equivalent_but_not_faster: Optimize dense-mask execution or add a workload-specific routing policy before another quality-training experiment.
